description: Hand-labelled clip-selection gold set. For each sample, gold_clips are the transcript spans a newsroom editor would plausibly clip for social distribution (concrete events, casualties, sports results, direct quotes, research findings). The remaining sentences are encyclopedic/trivia distractors. Spans are in seconds against the sample's reference-segment timeline. Labelled by the author; small by design and honest about it.
